consumerOwner.name: X-BB-Consumer-Key
consumerOwner.description: 32 random bytes, unpadded base64url, persisted before enrollment; local consumer capability, never a server credential.

validation_error.recovery: Fix the request; never echo input values or unknown field names.

unsupported_version.recovery: No shared version; never fall back to unguarded v1.

unauthenticated.recovery: Use existing login MCP; no token in this protocol.

stale_identity.recovery: Refresh auth state; reconcile old operations under original account.

stale_binding.recovery: Missing/wrong owner capability or CAS conflict; explicit rebind, no replay.

consumption_gap.recovery: Read and confirm this consumer's missing contiguous receipts.

migration_required.recovery: Retain evidence; no copying legacy account-wide cursor.

idempotency_conflict.recovery: Same operation/attempt ID with different intent; do not send.

not_found.recovery: Absent or outside caller scope; not proof an uncertain operation never ran.

storage_unavailable.recovery: No success/ACK unless durable; reconcile after recovery.

upstream_unavailable.recovery: Outcome may be uncertain; query original operation ID.

upstream_timeout.recovery: Outcome may be uncertain; query original operation ID.

x-bb-v1-policy: Strict payloads unchanged. Verified legacy alias only; never automatically downgrade.
